verbId.description: The capability verb to run — the backing skill's NAME (e.g. 'gmail_send'). One of verbId/skillId is required.

parameters.description: The capability's own inputs, passed to the skill sandbox as `args` — e.g. { to, subject, body } for gmail_send.

workspaceId.description: Acting workspace — an optional lens narrowing the skill lookup and the gate. Omit for a pod-wide run.

connectionSelector.description: Which of the capability's connections this run uses, when it has more than one. A selector matching nothing fails the run.

idempotencyKey.description: A stable key correlating retries of THIS logical run, so an external-send verb is at-most-once. Omitted → a content hash is derived.

channelId.description: Instruction-provenance: the acting channel of this agent turn. A run triggered from an untrusted-origin channel force-proposes instead of auto-running.

sourceMessageId.description: The triggering inbound message id, resolved server-side to the acting channel when channelId is not passed explicitly.

sessionId.description: The focus session this run belongs to. Persisted as the proposals.session_id column so a reviewer sees which operation the action was part of.
